title: Floating Panel: KRunner pop up clips into floating top Panel.
line: KRunner at the top of the screen now opens below a floating top panel instead of overlapping it.
explanation: A floating panel's exclusive zone is only its thickness, so maximized windows can slide under the floating gap. KRunner in its top position is a layer-shell surface placed at the edge of that exclusive zone, so it started inside the floating gap and overlapped the panel's lower part by about 8 px. KRunner now asks plasmashell's StrutManager over D-Bus for the active screen's available rect (which already counts the floating gap) and, when there is a top panel, places itself that far from the screen edge, ignoring other exclusive zones. Without plasmashell, or with no top panel, it behaves as before.

commits.message:
krunner: place the top bar below floating panels

Floating panels only reserve their thickness, so KRunner at the top of
the screen overlapped the gap under a floating top panel. It now asks
plasmashell for the space panels really take and places itself below it.

BUG: 502508

media.caption: Floating top panel, KRunner in its top position: KRunner's bar overlaps the panel's bottom edge
Same setup with the fix: KRunner opens just below the panel

review.text: The diagnosis is right (a floating panel only reserves its thickness, so the layer-shell KRunner starts inside the floating gap) and the after shot shows KRunner below the panel. But the fix adds a blocking D-Bus call from KRunner to plasmashell (and now also to KWin in top mode) on every show, so a busy or hung plasmashell delays or freezes KRunner, and it relies on the StrutManager interface that has already been proposed for removal. It also changes behaviour for Dodge/Windows-go-below top panels, which now push KRunner down although they reserve no space.
changes: Don't block KRunner's show on plasmashell: make the StrutManager query asynchronous (or cache it and update on change), with the current placement as the fallback
Only add the floating gap for floating panels that reserve space; keep Dodge/Windows-go-below/auto-hide top panels behaving as before
Ask the plasma-workspace maintainers whether StrutManager is an acceptable dependency for KRunner, or expose the floating gap in a supported way
